description: Standards and Regulatory Drift Audit across Biometrics, Cryptography, and Privacy Law

standards.title: ISO/IEC 19794-5:2011 / ISO/IEC 29794-5:2024 (Biometric data interchange formats - Face)
standards.cited_clause: Frontal face capture, inter-pupillary distance >= 60px, pose deviation <= 15 deg
standards.repo_status: COMPLIANT (Quality gate checks IPD and yaw/pitch)

standards.title: ISO/IEC 30107-3:2023 (Presentation attack detection - Testing and reporting)
standards.cited_clause: APCER / BPCER reporting, Level 1 & Level 2 2D print/replay attack types

standards.title: ISO/IEC 24745:2022 (Biometric information protection)
standards.cited_clause: Irreversibility, Unlinkability, Renewability of biometric templates
standards.repo_status: RESTATED (S3 claimed keyed rotation achieves 24745; S6 attack T-02/T-03 refutes cryptographic security)

standards.title: ISO/IEC 30136:2018 (Performance testing of biometric template protection schemes)
standards.cited_clause: Mated vs non-mated distance distributions, Gomez-Barrero D_lr unlinkability metric
standards.repo_status: APPLIED (Implemented in Track T unlinkability evaluation)

standards.title: UIDAI Face RD Service Specification v2.1
standards.cited_clause: PID block encryption using UIDAI public certificate, signed device info, PID XML schema
standards.repo_status: MAPPED (Contract stubbed; production requires STQC certification)

standards.title: STQC Biometric Device Certification Scheme for Face RD
standards.cited_clause: Hardware security environment, key storage in TEE/SE, anti-spoofing certification
standards.repo_status: NOT CERTIFIED (Documented as gap in Scorecard B)

standards.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India)
standards.cited_clause: Section 4-9 (Notice, Consent, Purpose Limitation), Section 12 (Erasure), Section 15 (Fiduciary obligations)
standards.repo_status: COMPLIANT (Zero raw image retention, envelope crypto-shredding, purpose-limited embeddings)
